Fig. 3.2. Data Center Map: Number of Data Centers by State
A data center can employ as few as 10 or more than 100 people, depending on its size, and supports 6.5
jobs for every one person directly employed.
If data centers turn out to be the economic development
engine they have been touted as, then that may drive population growth, further increasing the demand
for both water and electricity. For example, the Columbus, Ohio metropolitan area, where data centers are
being constructed at a very rapid rate, was the fastest-growing city in the U.S. for the second half of 2023
